node.title: Re: This is a useless node
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I asked a question, then realized that there was no point in asking what I was asking.

Don't worry, just about everyone here has had moments like that. [id://17557] explains a bit more about what the others have said, that it's best to either edit your original post (or answer your own question), so that others who may have the same question can learn from it.
